title: Shift of gate references
statement: For a natural number offset $o$, shifting a gate leaves input variables and the constant $1$ unchanged. In an addition, subtraction, or multiplication gate, it adds $o$ to each operand index.
hypotheses_covered: A gate that is an input variable, the constant $1$, addition, subtraction, or multiplication
